title: 第12章 胡大师第13章 白蛇
slug: 昆仑山修仙下山后我无敌了
content_zh:
“大叔谁跟你打的电话啊？”
“小峰，谁的电话？”
……
在陈锋挂掉电话后，许菲菲和陈泠汐都默默地看着陈锋。
“没事，一个朋友，你们自己开车回去吧，路上注意安全。”
陈锋微微一笑，直接将手上的车钥匙递给了小姑妈，他知道小姑妈以前是学过驾照的是会开车的。
陈泠汐点了点头，她带着闺蜜进入了路虎车里，然后车子很快就消失了。
在小姑妈离开后，陈锋则直接去了附近的那家茶餐厅门口等待起来。
大概过了半个时辰的样子，陈锋就听到了熟悉的螺旋桨的声音，他看到天空上出现了一架熟悉的白色波音直升飞机，这明显就是李家大少爷的专人座驾，因为在硕大的楚州只有李聪聪的座驾是波音直升机。
飞机落下来后舱门开启，一身白色西服头发梳得油亮的李聪聪从里面走了出来，他直接奔到了陈锋的面前，哀求道：“陈大师救我啊。”
他直接给陈锋跪了下来。
“先起来，到底是怎么回事？”
陈锋更加诧异的，也不知道什么时候把李大少爷吓成了这个样子。
“是这样的，陈大师你看看这是什么？”
李聪聪直接用手从身上掏出来一个塑料袋子，将袋子里面的东西递给了陈锋。
陈锋仔细一看，这似乎是一块白色的鳞片，好像是白蛇的鳞片。
“这到底是？”
陈锋眉毛一挑，似乎想到了什么。
“没错和陈大师你想的一样，上次陈大师不是赐予我一张符箓，用符箓斩杀了那条来我家捣乱的黑蛇吗？那条黑蛇的尸体说实话被我让厨师给炖了分给保镖吃了。但是就在昨天晚上，我家里竟然又出现了一条巨大无比的白蛇，那白蛇比黑蛇还要厉害，它直接将我家那些保镖，主要是吃过黑蛇肉的保镖全部杀死了，因为事出突然当时压根没来得及拍摄视频，不过我在现场也只是捡到了那白蛇的鳞片。”
“陈大师，你说那白蛇是不是和上次那个您的符箓斩杀的黑蛇的一伙的，它是来为黑蛇报仇来了啊？它会不会对付我，虽然我没吃黑蛇肉，不过我尝了一口黑蛇汤的，那黑蛇汤很腥。”

李聪聪娓娓道来，他心里害怕的很。
李聪聪也没说谎，他昨天晚上不在家因为当时他在外面和女伴开房方才避免了白蛇攻击，也没看到白蛇。
不过等他接到下人的电话赶回去的时候，别墅后花园里已经狼狈不堪，白蛇直接杀死了他的10个保镖，保镖死的凄惨无比，有的被咬断了脖子，有的四肢分离，场面血腥残忍。
李聪聪因为害怕，所以这才找陈锋。
“哦，这个不好说，这样吧我先去你家里去看看去。”
陈锋想了想则打算去李聪聪家里去看看情况，两人直接上了波音直升飞机。
李聪聪的家住在楚州郊区的燕山角落下，这里非常偏僻荒凉与世隔绝。
不过李聪聪家里有钱，他毕竟是顶级富二代，他的家的别墅足足有两个篮球场那么大，配备了游泳池，花园，高尔夫球场等等非常奢华的设施，也配备了很多安保，而发生事故的地点主要是在他家后花园里。
后花园里种植着大量的梅花，桃花，琼花等等，花朵多彩绚丽，芳香馥郁。
不过昨晚因为白蛇的攻击，导致很多花朵都被压坏了，很多花朵的上面都满是红色的血液，看起来是触目惊心。
“陈大师，昨天我的手下就在这里遭遇到了白蛇的攻击，你看这些压坏的花。”
从直升机下来后，来到别墅后花园后，李聪聪用手指着面前一大片被压坏的花丛则说道。花丛上可以清楚的看到很多黑色血液和白色的鳞片，甚至还有很多花朵直接被融化了，也不知道为什么。
不过就在此刻，李聪聪的手机忽然响了起来，他连忙接了电话。
“好的好的，我马上去接你。”
李聪聪放下电话后很是高兴。
“什么情况？谁来了？”
陈锋好奇的询问。
“是这样的，胡大师来了”
content_en:
"Uncle, who called you?"
"Xiao Feng, whose phone number is it?"
…
After Chen Feng hung up the phone, Xu Feifei and Chen Lingxi both looked at Chen Feng silently.
"It's okay, a friend, you can drive back by yourself, and pay attention to safety on the road."
Chen Feng smiled slightly and handed the car key directly to his little aunt. He knew that his little aunt had learned a driver's license before and knew how to drive.
Chen Lingxi nodded, she took her best friend into the Land Rover, and the car quickly disappeared.
After his little aunt left, Chen Feng went directly to the door of the nearby tea restaurant and waited.
About half an hour later, Chen Feng heard the familiar sound of propellers and saw a familiar white Boeing helicopter appearing in the sky. This was obviously the eldest son of the Li family's special vehicle, because in the huge Chuzhou, only Li Congcong's vehicle was a Boeing helicopter.
After the plane landed, the cabin door opened, and Li Congcong, wearing a white suit and combed hair, walked out. He ran directly to Chen Feng and begged: "Master Chen, please save me."
He knelt down directly to Chen Feng.
"Get up first, what's going on?"
Chen Feng was even more surprised. He didn't know when he scared Young Master Li into this state.
"That's it. Master Chen, look at what this is?"
Li Congcong directly took out a plastic bag from his body and handed the contents of the bag to Chen Feng.
Chen Feng took a closer look and saw that it seemed to be a white scale, like the scales of a white snake.
"What is this?"
Chen Feng raised his eyebrows, as if he thought of something.
"Yes, it's what you thought, Master Chen. Didn't Master Chen give me a talisman last time and use it to kill the black snake that came to my house to cause trouble? To be honest, I asked the chef to stew the body of the black snake and share it with the bodyguards. But just last night, it appeared again in my house. I caught a huge white snake, which was even more powerful than the black snake. It killed all my bodyguards, mainly those who had eaten the black snake’s meat. Because the incident happened so suddenly, I didn’t even have time to take a video, but I only picked up the scales of the white snake at the scene.”
"Master Chen, do you think that the white snake is part of the same group as the black snake that your talisman killed last time? Is it here to avenge the black snake? Will it deal with me? Although I didn't eat the black snake meat, I took a taste of the black snake soup. The black snake soup was very fishy."
Li Congcong said eloquently that he was very scared.
Li Congcong didn't lie either. He was not at home last night because he was staying outside with his female companion to avoid the White Snake's attack. He did not see the White Snake either.
However, when he received a call from his servant and rushed back, the garden behind the villa was already in a state of panic. White Snake directly killed 10 of his bodyguards. The bodyguards died in extremely miserable ways. Some had their necks bitten off, and some had their limbs separated. The scene was bloody and cruel.
Li Congcong came to Chen Feng because he was afraid.
"Oh, that's hard to say. Let me go to your house first and take a look."
After thinking about it, Chen Feng decided to go to Li Congcong's house to check on the situation, and the two of them boarded the Boeing helicopter directly.
Li Congcong's family lives in the corner of Yanshan on the outskirts of Chuzhou, which is very remote, desolate and isolated from the world.
However, Li Congcong's family is rich. He is the second generation of the top rich after all. His family's villa is as big as two basketball courts. It is equipped with very luxurious facilities such as swimming pools, gardens, golf courses, etc. It is also equipped with a lot of security. The accident happened mainly in the back garden of his home.
There are a large number of plum blossoms, peach blossoms, viburnums, etc. planted in the back garden. The flowers are colorful and fragrant.
However, due to the attack of the white snake last night, many flowers were crushed, and many flowers were covered with red blood, which looked shocking.
"Master Chen, yesterdayMy men were attacked by the white snake here. Look at these crushed flowers. "
After getting off the helicopter and arriving at the back garden of the villa, Li Congcong pointed at a large patch of crushed flowers in front of him and said. You can clearly see a lot of black blood and white scales on the flowers. There are even many flowers that have been directly melted. I don't know why.
But at this moment, Li Congcong's cell phone suddenly rang, and he quickly answered the call.
"Okay, okay, I'll pick you up right away. "
Li Congcong was very happy after putting down the phone.
"What's going on? Who is coming? "
Chen Feng asked curiously.
"That's it, Master Hu is here."
